answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock: a new agent posts a 10-unit bond, locked until a unique fingerprint forms over 20 epochs. An atlas of past behavior maps each agent's timing and partners, like water cutting distinct channels through karst rock. Clones repeat the same timing and partners, so their fingerprints match and the bond burns. Forging 1,000 clones wastes 10,000 units. An honest agent pays once, lands at its own jetty, and unlocks its bond.
